name: valo-web
description: WebGPU-native 2D rendering with a retained API and Canvas2D adapter

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build ../../crates/valo-web --target web --out-dir ../../packages/valo-web/wasm --out-name valo_web --no-pack && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('wasm/.gitignore', { force: true })"
scripts.build:wasm:compat: wasm-pack build ../../crates/valo-web --target web --out-dir ../../packages/valo-web/wasm-compat --out-name valo_web --no-pack --features webgl && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('wasm-compat/.gitignore', { force: true })"
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:wasm:compat && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:wasm:compat && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && tsc -p playground/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:playground: npm run build && vite build playground
